description: Defines the enum RescheduleType, representing different types of rescheduling options for holidays or repayments, including methods for conversion and validation.

classes.name: RescheduleType
classes.description: An enumeration for different rescheduling types with associated integer codes and string identifiers, including utility methods for conversion and checks.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an Integer value to the corresponding RescheduleType enum, defaulting to INVALID if no match.

methods.name: isRescheduleToSpecificDate
methods.description: Checks if the current RescheduleType instance corresponds to rescheduling to a specific date.

methods.name: isResheduleToNextRepaymentDate
methods.description: Checks if the current RescheduleType instance corresponds to rescheduling to the next repayment date.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with this RescheduleType.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code identifier for this RescheduleType.
